# 1 Enoch Chapter 64 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**64:1** And-after-that I-saw another host of-angels — terrible-ones — who-were-with-women, and-their-forms were-like-men.

**64:2** And-they-said unto-me: These are-the-angels who-descended-from-heaven to-the-earth, and-have-disclosed-to-them the-hidden knowledge, and-have-seduced-the-daughters-of-men into-sin. And-the-sons-of-men have-not-been-able-to-preserve-themselves from-them, and-have-taken-wives from-among-them.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Hyphenated compounds preserve Ge'ez construct chains. Ch. 64 is the shortest chapter in the Parables — a transitional fragment connecting the judgment of the kings (ch. 62-63) to the extended fallen-angel section (ch. 65-69). The 'terrible ones' who descended are the Watchers of ch. 6-16. 'Hidden knowledge' (Ge'ez mestir) is the technical term for the forbidden revelations.*
